<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from the scixplorer source. Do not edit: run `uv run python scripts/gen_docs.py`. -->

Each row is a Python expression and the Solr query string that `scix.search.to_solr()` compiles it to. The table is generated by compiling every expression, so it is always what the client sends. Conditions on other models are resolved against the packaged data; the identifier lists depend on the version of that data.

Expressions use `import scixplorer as scix` and `import datetime`.

## Keyword fields

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N"` | `bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N"` | matched literally |
| `scix.Document.bibcode.exact("2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N"` | the same: nothing to expand, no `=` |
| `scix.Document.doctype != "eprint"` | `*:* AND -doctype:"eprint"` |  |
| `scix.Document.bibstem.in_(["ApJ", "AJ"])` | `bibstem:("ApJ" OR "AJ")` |  |
| `scix.Document.doctype.not_in(["eprint", "abstract"])` | `*:* AND -doctype:("eprint" OR "abstract")` |  |
| `scix.Document.doi == "10.1086/300499"` | `doi:"10.1086/300499"` |  |
| `scix.Document.id == 1406395` | `id:"1406395"` | an `int` is accepted for `id` |
| `scix.Document.volume == "808"` | `volume:"808"` | volumes are strings |
| `scix.Document.bibcode.like("2015ApJ...808*")` | `bibcode:2015ApJ...808*` |  |
| `scix.Document.bibcode.startswith("2016arXiv")` | `bibcode:2016arXiv*` |  |

## Text fields

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.title == "dark matter halo"` | `title:"dark matter halo"` | a phrase, with synonyms |
| `scix.Document.title.exact("dark matter halo")` | `=title:"dark matter halo"` | without synonyms |
| `scix.Document.abs == "exoplanet atmospheres"` | `abs:"exoplanet atmospheres"` | title, abstract and keywords |
| `scix.Document.full == "Gaia"` | `full:"Gaia"` | also the full text |
| `scix.Document.title == 'the "big" one'` | `title:"the \"big\" one"` | quotes are escaped |
| `scix.Document.title.like("JWST")` | `title:JWST` | no implicit wildcard |
| `scix.Document.title.like("exoplanet*")` | `title:exoplanet*` |  |
| `scix.Document.title.like("star-form*")` | `title:star\-form*` |  |
| `scix.Document.title.like("colo?r")` | `title:colo?r` | `?` is one character |
| `scix.Document.title.like("star%")` | `title:star*` | `%` is the same as `*` |
| `scix.Document.title.contains("astro")` | `title:*astro*` |  |
| `scix.Document.title.startswith("The Cannon")` | `title:"The Cannon*"` | a pattern with a space is quoted |
| `scix.Document.keyword.in_(["galaxies", "quasars"], exact=True)` | `=keyword:"galaxies" OR =keyword:"quasars"` |  |
| `scix.Document.aff == "Max-Planck"` | `aff:"Max-Planck"` |  |
| `scix.Document.uat_name == "exoplanets"` | `uat:"exoplanets"` | the text of the UAT concepts |

## Name fields and positions

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.author == "Murray, S"` | `author:"Murray, S"` | with name variants |
| `scix.Document.author.exact("Murray, Stephen")` | `=author:"Murray, Stephen"` | only that form |
| `scix.Document.first_author == "Ness, M"` | `first_author:"Ness, M"` |  |
| `scix.Document.author[0] == "Ness, M"` | `pos(author:"Ness, M", 1)` | first author |
| `scix.Document.author[1] == "Hogg, D"` | `pos(author:"Hogg, D", 2)` | second author |
| `scix.Document.author[0:3] == "Hogg, D"` | `pos(author:"Hogg, D", 1, 3)` | any of the first three |
| `scix.Document.author[1].exact("Hogg, David W")` | `pos(=author:"Hogg, David W", 2)` |  |
| `scix.Document.author.like("Casey, A*")` | `author:"Casey, A*"` |  |
| `scix.Document.author.in_(["Casey, A", "Ness, M"], exact=True)` | `=author:"Casey, A" OR =author:"Ness, M"` |  |
| `scix.Document.orcid == "0000-0002-1825-0097"` | `orcid:"0000-0002-1825-0097"` | any of the three ORCID fields |

## Numbers

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.year == 2015` | `year:2015` |  |
| `scix.Document.year != 2015` | `*:* AND -year:2015` |  |
| `scix.Document.year.between(2018, 2020)` | `year:[2018 TO 2020]` | inclusive |
| `scix.Document.year > 2020` | `year:[2021 TO *]` | exclusive bound moved by one |
| `scix.Document.year >= 2020` | `year:[2020 TO *]` |  |
| `scix.Document.citation_count < 10` | `citation_count:[* TO 9]` |  |
| `scix.Document.citation_count <= 10` | `citation_count:[* TO 10]` |  |
| `scix.Document.year.in_([2019, 2021])` | `year:(2019 OR 2021)` |  |
| `scix.Document.citation_count_norm > 0.5` | `citation_count_norm:[0.5 TO *] AND -citation_count_norm:0.5` | a float bound is excluded explicitly |
| `scix.Document.citation_count_norm.between(0.5, 2.0)` | `citation_count_norm:[0.5 TO 2.0]` |  |

## Dates

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.pubdate.between(datetime.date(2020, 1, 1), datetime.date(2020, 6, 30))` | `pubdate:[2020-01 TO 2020-06]` | month precision |
| `scix.Document.pubdate >= "2020-03"` | `pubdate:[2020-03 TO *]` |  |
| `scix.Document.pubdate > "2020-03"` | `pubdate:[2020-04 TO *]` | the next month |
| `scix.Document.entry_date >= datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1)` | `entry_date:["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z" TO *]` | UTC timestamps are quoted |
| `scix.Document.date == datetime.datetime(2015, 7, 1)` | `date:"2015-07-01T00:00:00Z"` |  |
| `scix.Document.entry_date >= scix.days_ago(7)` | `entry_date:[NOW-7DAYS TO *]` | evaluated by SciX |
| `scix.Document.entry_date <= scix.now()` | `entry_date:[* TO NOW]` |  |

## Combining

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `(scix.Document.year == 2020) & (scix.Document.bibstem == "ApJ")` | `year:2020 AND bibstem:"ApJ"` |  |
| `(scix.Document.year == 2020) \| (scix.Document.year == 2022)` | `year:2020 OR year:2022` |  |
| `((scix.Document.year == 2020) \| (scix.Document.year == 2022)) & (scix.Document.bibstem == "ApJ")` | `(year:2020 OR year:2022) AND bibstem:"ApJ"` | nested groups are parenthesised |
| `(scix.Document.year == 2020) & ~(scix.Document.bibstem == "ApJ")` | `year:2020 AND -bibstem:"ApJ"` |  |
| `~(scix.Document.year == 2020)` | `*:* AND -year:2020` | a negation on its own is anchored |
| `~(scix.Document.year == 2020) & ~(scix.Document.bibstem == "ApJ")` | `*:* AND -year:2020 AND -bibstem:"ApJ"` |  |
| `(scix.Document.year == 2020) \| ~(scix.Document.bibstem == "ApJ")` | `year:2020 OR (*:* AND -bibstem:"ApJ")` |  |
| `~((scix.Document.year == 2020) & (scix.Document.bibstem == "ApJ"))` | `*:* AND -(year:2020 AND bibstem:"ApJ")` |  |
| `scix.Document.raw('abs:"dark energy" OR abs:"cosmological constant"') & (scix.Document.year < 2000)` | `(abs:"dark energy" OR abs:"cosmological constant") AND year:[* TO 1999]` | raw Solr is parenthesised when nested |

## Documents and libraries

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.in_(["2015ApJ...808...16N", "1995Natur.378..355M"])` | `bibcode:("2015ApJ...808...16N" OR "1995Natur.378..355M")` |  |
| `scix.Document.not_in(["2015ApJ...808...16N"]) & (scix.Document.year >= 2015)` | `-bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N" AND year:[2015 TO *]` |  |
| `scix.Document.in_(scix.Library(id="Rk3bq7xQTgS0vVZ2mN8cWw"))` | `docs(library/Rk3bq7xQTgS0vVZ2mN8cWw)` | tested by SciX |
| `scix.Document.not_in(scix.Library(id="Rk3bq7xQTgS0vVZ2mN8cWw")) & (scix.Document.year > 2015)` | `-docs(library/Rk3bq7xQTgS0vVZ2mN8cWw) AND year:[2016 TO *]` |  |

## Through other models

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.journal == "AJ"` | `bibstem:"AJ"` | an abbreviation is used as given |
| `scix.Document.journal.in_(["ApJ", "AJ", "MNRAS"])` | `bibstem:("ApJ" OR "AJ" OR "MNRAS")` |  |
| `scix.Document.journal.title.startswith("The Astrophysical Journal")` | `bibstem:("ApJ" OR "ApJS")` | resolved against the packaged journal list |
| `scix.Journal.title == "Icarus"` | `bibstem:"Icar"` | a condition on Journal fields goes through the document's journal |
| `scix.Document.affiliation == "A01400"` | `aff_id:"A01400"` |  |
| `scix.Document.affiliation.any((scix.Affiliation.country_code == "AU") & (scix.Affiliation.abbreviation == "Dep Phy"))` | `aff_id:("A11677" OR "A00307" OR "A11671" OR "A00733")` | one affiliation meets both |
| `scix.Document.affiliation.abbreviation == "MPIA Heidelberg"` | `aff_id:"A01570"` |  |
| `scix.Document.uat == 498` | `uat_id:498` | an identifier needs no downloaded data |
| `scix.Document.planetary_feature == 2071` | `planetary_feature_id:2071` |  |

## Authors

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.authors.any(scix.Author.name == "Ness, M")` | `author:"Ness, M"` | the same as the shorthand |
| `scix.Document.authors[0].name == "Ness, M"` | `pos(author:"Ness, M", 1)` |  |
| `scix.Document.authors[0].affiliation.abbreviation == "IoA"` | `pos(aff_id:("A00319" OR "A13064"), 1)` |  |
| `scix.Document.authors[1].aff == "Max-Planck"` | `pos(aff:"Max-Planck", 2)` |  |
| `scix.Document.authors[0:3].any(scix.Author.name == "Hogg, D")` | `pos(author:"Hogg, D", 1, 3)` |  |
| `scix.Document.authors.any((scix.Author.name == "Hogg, D") \| (scix.Author.name == "Ness, M"))` | `author:"Hogg, D" OR author:"Ness, M"` | an `\|` inside is exact |
| `scix.Document.authors[0].any((scix.Author.name == "Ness, M") & (scix.Author.aff_id == "A01570"))` | `pos(author:"Ness, M", 1) AND pos(aff_id:"A01570", 1)` | one position: exact |
| `scix.Document.authors.any((scix.Author.name == "Hogg, D") & (scix.Author.aff_id == "A01570"))` | `author:"Hogg, D" AND aff_id:"A01570"` | necessary condition only; checked on each result |
| `scix.Document.authors.all(scix.Author.aff_id == "A01570") & (scix.Document.year == 2015)` | `aff_id:"A01570" AND year:2015` | necessary condition only; checked on each result |
| `scix.Document.authors[0].email == "ness@example.org"` | `email:"ness@example.org"` | not searched by position; checked on each result |

## Operators

| Python | Solr | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `scix.Document.citations(scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `citations(bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N")` |  |
| `scix.Document.references(scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `references(bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N")` |  |
| `scix.Document.trending(scix.Document.abs == "exoplanets")` | `trending(abs:"exoplanets")` |  |
| `scix.Document.useful(scix.Document.abs == "stellar spectroscopy")` | `useful(abs:"stellar spectroscopy")` |  |
| `scix.Document.reviews(scix.Document.abs == "gravitational waves")` | `reviews(abs:"gravitational waves")` |  |
| `scix.Document.instructive(scix.Document.abs == "gravitational waves")` | `instructive(abs:"gravitational waves")` |  |
| `scix.Document.similar(scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `similar(bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N")` |  |
| `scix.Document.citis(scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `citis(bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N")` |  |
| `scix.Document.classic_relevance(scix.Document.abs == "dark energy")` | `classic_relevance(abs:"dark energy")` |  |
| `scix.Document.join_citations(scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `joincitations(bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N")` |  |
| `scix.Document.join_references(scix.Document.bibcode == "2015ApJ...808...16N")` | `joinreferences(bibcode:"2015ApJ...808...16N")` |  |
| `scix.Document.reviews2(scix.Document.abs == "dark energy")` | `reviews2(abs:"dark energy")` |  |
| `scix.Document.useful2(scix.Document.abs == "dark energy")` | `useful2(abs:"dark energy")` |  |
| `scix.Document.trending("exoplanets")` | `trending(exoplanets)` | a string is raw Solr |
| `scix.Document.top_n(10, scix.Document.year == 2020, order_by=scix.Document.citation_count.desc())` | `topn(10, year:2020, citation_count desc)` |  |
| `scix.Document.top_n(5, scix.Document.author == "Hogg, D")` | `topn(5, author:"Hogg, D")` | by relevance |
| `scix.Document.pos('author:"Ness, M"', 1)` | `pos(author:"Ness, M", 1)` |  |
| `scix.Document.pos(scix.Document.aff == "Heidelberg", 1, 2)` | `pos(aff:"Heidelberg", 1, 2)` |  |
